title: Lightly Charred Portuguese Fish Skillet
description: A satvik-friendly Portuguese dish featuring lightly charred fish, molten flavors, and a hint of malt vinegar, all cooked to perfection in a tava-griddle.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large tava-griddle over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and saute for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the thinly sliced onion and bell pepper, and cook for 3-4 minutes until they start to soften.
Add the cod fish pieces and cook for 4-5 minutes per side, until they are lightly charred and cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the malt vinegar, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Pour the malt vinegar mixture over the fish and vegetables, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 2-3 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
Let the dish rest for 2-3 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to settle.
